__comment: The Overhaul main menu's Library scene: an enchanter's study at night (the set itself is LibrarySet). Framed wider than the hearth: the camera stands inside the room, which runs on behind it, and looks down a long hall of shelves to a window far off, the enchanting table on the left and the desk and the tall bookcase on the right. A scene captured in the game (/slate scene capture <template> cfhgui:title/library) replaces the set with its structure.
